facts.text: Aleen was a rocky planet located within the Bright Jewel sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim.

evidence.quote: Aleen was a rocky planet located within the Bright Jewel sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim.

facts.text: It was home to the diminutive, terrestrial Aleena species, and the Kindalo, a bioluminescent, tree-like species.

evidence.quote: It was home to the diminutive, terrestrial Aleena species, and the Kindalo, a bioluminescent, tree-like species.

facts.text: After that war, however, the two species agreed to live separately and had a seal created to keep the surface-dwelling Aleena apart from the subterranean Kindalo, as well as separate the two atmospheres of the planet.

evidence.quote: After that war, however, the two species agreed to live separately and had a seal created to keep the surface-dwelling Aleena apart from the subterranean Kindalo, as well as separate the two atmospheres of the planet.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic arrived to help the Aleena rebuild after a series of devastating groundquakes, during which the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 encountered both sides of the Aleen conflict.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic arrived to help the Aleena rebuild after a series of devastating groundquakes, during which the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 encountered both sides of the Aleen conflict.

facts.text: From space, Aleen appeared as a rocky, brown, desert planet, and possessed a variety of terrains such as mesas, deserts, shallow seas, and isolated forests.

evidence.quote: From space, Aleen appeared as a rocky, brown, desert planet, and possessed a variety of terrains such as mesas, deserts, shallow seas, and isolated forests.

facts.text: Its surface was dominated by arbozoic trees, found close to settlements with their roots hanging over the edges of the mesas.

evidence.quote: Its surface was dominated by arbozoic trees, found close to settlements with their roots hanging over the edges of the mesas.

facts.text: Dead arbozoic trees were at one point in the planet's history hollowed out to create the "Aleen colossi," which remain important in Aleena culture.

evidence.quote: Dead arbozoic trees were at one point in the planet's history hollowed out to create the "Aleen colossi," which remain important in Aleena culture.

facts.text: Aleen's uniqueness stemmed from the series of complex caverns located in its upper crust, considered to be part of a distinct subterranean biome with its own atmosphere separate from that of the surface and not breathable to most sentient species.

evidence.quote: Aleen's uniqueness stemmed from the series of complex caverns located in its upper crust, considered to be part of a distinct subterranean biome with its own atmosphere separate from that of the surface and not breathable to most sentient species.

facts.text: Formed by the growth of the arbozoic trees, the caverns were built-up of tunnels carved by water, lava, and tectonic shearing.

evidence.quote: Formed by the growth of the arbozoic trees, the caverns were built-up of tunnels carved by water, lava, and tectonic shearing.

facts.text: Fostering a separate climate, and an atmosphere that was toxic to the surface-dwelling Aleena, the planet's two sentient species consciously decided to recognize the divide between the two biomes and remained separated.

evidence.quote: Fostering a separate climate, and an atmosphere that was toxic to the surface-dwelling Aleena, the planet's two sentient species consciously decided to recognize the divide between the two biomes and remained separated.

facts.text: The human-centric scholarship of the Galactic Empire knew that the Aleena, and possibly the Kindalo, were client species of the Rakatan Infinite Empire, though there was little evidence of any occupation.

evidence.quote: The human-centric scholarship of the Galactic Empire knew that the Aleena, and possibly the Kindalo, were client species of the Rakatan Infinite Empire, though there was little evidence of any occupation.

facts.text: Establishing a strong culture and a fierce army, the Aleena built towering monoliths that were vital to the religious orders that formed on the planet in the earliest days of the Galactic Republic, and long before the galactic community had discovered the world.

evidence.quote: Establishing a strong culture and a fierce army, the Aleena built towering monoliths that were vital to the religious orders that formed on the planet in the earliest days of the Galactic Republic, and long before the galactic community had discovered the world.

facts.text: Some years later, the Aleena came into conflict with the Kindalo that lived beneath the surface of the world, and the two cultures waged a terrible war that greatly damaged both societies through the use of technological weapons.

evidence.quote: Some years later, the Aleena came into conflict with the Kindalo that lived beneath the surface of the world, and the two cultures waged a terrible war that greatly damaged both societies through the use of technological weapons.

facts.text: The individual settlements across the planet maintained contact with a planetary government that advised the King of Aleen, a ceremonial role usually held by distinguished priests.

evidence.quote: The individual settlements across the planet maintained contact with a planetary government that advised the King of Aleen, a ceremonial role usually held by distinguished priests.

facts.text: The Kindalo in turn kept to a sort of anarchic consensus form of government.

evidence.quote: The Kindalo in turn kept to a sort of anarchic consensus form of government.

facts.text: In 230 BBY, Aleen was attacked by the Nihil as a distraction for the Jedi and Republic.
entities: The High Republic: The Fallen Star

evidence.quote: In 230 BBY, Aleen was attacked by the Nihil as a distraction for the Jedi and Republic.

facts.text: During the war, a series of groundquakes led the Republic to send a humanitarian mission, when the Great Seal became dislodged and the two atmospheres began to intermix.

evidence.quote: During the war, a series of groundquakes led the Republic to send a humanitarian mission, when the Great Seal became dislodged and the two atmospheres began to intermix.

facts.text: When the Galactic Empire came to power at the end of the war, the Empire established an observation post and listening station on Aleen's lone moon, Trohlu.

evidence.quote: When the Galactic Empire came to power at the end of the war, the Empire established an observation post and listening station on Aleen's lone moon, Trohlu.

facts.text: The Stormtrooper Corps once carried out a mission on Aleen, in which a village of Aleena was attacked.

evidence.quote: The Stormtrooper Corps once carried out a mission on Aleen, in which a village of Aleena was attacked.

facts.text: The attack led to three stormtroopers deserting and fleeing to Nothoiin with an orphaned Aleena child.

evidence.quote: The attack led to three stormtroopers deserting and fleeing to Nothoiin with an orphaned Aleena child.

facts.text: The Imperial General Octavion Sorin once carried out weapons tests at a compound on Aleen.

evidence.quote: The Imperial General Octavion Sorin once carried out weapons tests at a compound on Aleen.

facts.text: The roleplaying sourcebook Nexus of Power incorrectly places Aleen on the Entralla Route, but all maps of the galaxy instead place it along the Celanon Spur.

evidence.quote: The roleplaying sourcebook Nexus of Power incorrectly places Aleen on the Entralla Route, but all maps of the galaxy instead place it along the Celanon Spur.

facts.text: Aleen was a planet located in the Mid Rim that contained two unique environs: the surface world inhabited by the Aleena and the Underworld, the domain of the Kindalo.

evidence.quote: Aleen was a planet located in the Mid Rim that contained two unique environs: the surface world inhabited by the Aleena and the Underworld, the domain of the Kindalo.

facts.text: A desert world on the surface, Aleen's upper crust contained a second major environ that contained a series of complex caverns with its own unique atmosphere.

evidence.quote: A desert world on the surface, Aleen's upper crust contained a second major environ that contained a series of complex caverns with its own unique atmosphere.

facts.text: Formed by the growth of the unique arbozoic trees, the caverns were also comprised of tunnels carved by water, lava, and tectonic sheering.

evidence.quote: Formed by the growth of the unique arbozoic trees, the caverns were also comprised of tunnels carved by water, lava, and tectonic sheering.

facts.text: Maintaining a unique climate and an atmosphere dangerous to the surface-dwelling Aleena, the Underworld was inhabited by the tree-like Kindalo and the mystical being, Orphne.

evidence.quote: Maintaining a unique climate and an atmosphere dangerous to the surface-dwelling Aleena, the Underworld was inhabited by the tree-like Kindalo and the mystical being, Orphne.

facts.text: Just as the Aleena could not breathe in the Underworld environment, Kindalo were harmed by the unfiltered oxygen of the surface world.

evidence.quote: Just as the Aleena could not breathe in the Underworld environment, Kindalo were harmed by the unfiltered oxygen of the surface world.

facts.text: Aleena colossi dotted the surface of the planet, standing as relics of their ancient society abandoned in favor of a simpler lifestyle.

evidence.quote: Aleena colossi dotted the surface of the planet, standing as relics of their ancient society abandoned in favor of a simpler lifestyle.

facts.text: Establishing a strong culture and a fierce army, the Aleena built towering monoliths that were vital to the religious orders that formed on the planet.

evidence.quote: Establishing a strong culture and a fierce army, the Aleena built towering monoliths that were vital to the religious orders that formed on the planet.

facts.text: The Infinite Empire controlled the planet at its height, and the Aleena and the Kindalo served as client species the reigning Rakata.

evidence.quote: The Infinite Empire controlled the planet at its height, and the Aleena and the Kindalo served as client species the reigning Rakata.

facts.text: After the Infinite Empire collapsed, the Aleena experienced an expansionist era, during which they settled other worlds and spread out into the greater galaxy.

evidence.quote: After the Infinite Empire collapsed, the Aleena experienced an expansionist era, during which they settled other worlds and spread out into the greater galaxy.

facts.text: Aleen Minor became a major colony of the Aleena species, and would go on to become the center of Aleena culture in the distant future.

evidence.quote: Aleen Minor became a major colony of the Aleena species, and would go on to become the center of Aleena culture in the distant future.

facts.text: The Aleena came into conflict with the Kindalo that lived beneath the surface of the world, and the two cultures waged a terrible civil war that caused great damage to both societies through the use of technological weapons.

evidence.quote: The Aleena came into conflict with the Kindalo that lived beneath the surface of the world, and the two cultures waged a terrible civil war that caused great damage to both societies through the use of technological weapons.

facts.text: When life on Aleen was nearly destroyed by the fighting, a compact was formed that secured the notion that neither society would interfere with the other again.

evidence.quote: When life on Aleen was nearly destroyed by the fighting, a compact was formed that secured the notion that neither society would interfere with the other again.

facts.text: Forming into kinship clades known as tahikos, the individual settlements maintained contact with a planetary government that advised the King of Aleen.

evidence.quote: Forming into kinship clades known as tahikos, the individual settlements maintained contact with a planetary government that advised the King of Aleen.

facts.text: The Kindalo thought the Aleena were responsible, and so caused massive groundquakes in retaliation, prompting the Republic to send a squad of clones led by Wolffe, also accompanied by C-3PO and R2-D2 for translation, to undergo a relief mission.

evidence.quote: The Kindalo thought the Aleena were responsible, and so caused massive groundquakes in retaliation, prompting the Republic to send a squad of clones led by Wolffe, also accompanied by C-3PO and R2-D2 for translation, to undergo a relief mission.

facts.text: When the Galactic Empire came to power at the end of the war, the Empire established a observation post on the moon of Trohlu.

evidence.quote: When the Galactic Empire came to power at the end of the war, the Empire established a observation post on the moon of Trohlu.

evidence.quote: Due to the discrepancies between the previous sources and the planet described in The Clone Wars TV series, Jason Fry stated that those Aleen are two different worlds.
